## Item 1 — Paint wipes on unhide (req_2660, data loss)

**Root cause** (hypothesis b, plus a deeper wrinkle): `meshSetGroupHidden` → `hideGroup`/`showGroup` → `replaceActiveEditMesh` → `setPaintTarget` → `model_paint.setTarget` → `clear()` **destroys the atlas outright** before the groups-driven `refreshPaintLayout` ever runs; the rebuild's only carry was per-face *centroid colour* (`rebuildLayoutInner` snap → `applyColors`), so every sub-face brush stroke was wiped on **each** eye toggle (hide and show alike). Not the journal (undo-only), not missing tint suspend (already in place).

**Fix**: island-level texel carry that survives the mid-op `clear()`:
- `framework/gpu/model_paint.zig` — carry stash + `snapshotAtlasForCarry()`/`dropAtlasCarry()`/`consumeAtlasCarry()` (~line 270), consumed in `rebuildLayoutInner` (~line 545): each new island whose authored group has a stashed twin gets its texels blitted old-rect→new-rect (nearest-resample if the density changed, e.g. FIT mode); flat-colour fallback only for unmatched islands.
- `framework/gpu/3d.zig` `meshSetGroupHidden` (~line 1654): tint-suspended snapshot before the op, dropped on failure.
- UV live refresh: hide/show already flows through `adoptMesh` → `refreshUvIfLive`; confirmed the panel rebuilds (the harness `paint:1` op now also calls `buildUvPanel`).

**Proof** (headless, `RJIT_MODELDOC=cube` + new meshops `hidepart/showpart/paint/stamp`): `addpart:cube; detail:64; paint:1; grouppaint(part2 green); hidepart:0,6; stamp×2 (hit face 1); atlas dump; showpart:0,6; atlas dump`. Hidden atlas 132×196: **288 red stroke px, 24288 green px**; after unhide, re-laid 198×262 atlas: **exactly 288 red / 24288 green** (PIL pixel counts; `a3b_shown.png` visually shows both paints + the restored grey islands). Partition audit OK before/after (`ownedFaces=24 totalFaces=24`).

**Left open**: other topo ops (loop cut/extrude/detach) still lose strokes by design ("stroke-program replay" contract); the same one-call stash could be applied there. Also `paint_program` records dabs by face index, which shifts across a hide — a program *saved* while a part is hidden replays misindexed (pre-existing; out of scope).

## Item 2 — Mode-state leak (req_2662)

**Root cause**: `AppFrame.selectPart` calls `__mesh_edit_select_group_range` when `selMode` is 0/3 — and paint mode reports selMode 0. An outliner click during paint forced `mesh_edit.g_mode = .face` (that door hard-sets it), applying the tint, and `drawGizmoOverlay` (gated only on `meshEditModeRaw() != 0`) drew the armed rotate rings. Exactly "i don't know how i got here".

**Fix** (chosen semantics: reset on paint entry, documented): new host paint session — `3d.zig setPaintSession` (clears selection + mode on entry) + `__mesh_paint_session` door (`v8_bindings_core.zig`); while live, selection doors are inert (`meshEditPick/Box/SelectFace/SelectGroupRange/SelectAll`, `meshGizmoHit/Nudge`) and `drawEditorOverlay` treats mode as 0 (stage/compass stay; wash/dots/edges/gizmo quiet). Cart side: ModelView mirrors `paintMode` through one effect (covers toolbar/hotkey/focus/fresh-load exits, plus unmount cleanup), and `selectPart` scopes-only during paint. Audited other transitions: vertex/edge/face handled by `setMode`'s tint drop; toolbar mode changes exit paint first.

**Proof**: control shot `mode:3;sel:2;gizmo:2` shows rings + tint (`r2662_control.png`); same + paint entry shows a clean cube, zero rings/tint/dressing (`r2662_paint.png`, re-verified on final binary `r2662_paint_final.png`).

## Item 3 — Outliner multi-select (req_2659)

- `AppFrame.tsx`: `selectedPartIds` set (shell-local — deliberately NOT in `data/types.ts`, which the parallel session owns) + shift accumulation in `selectPart` via `currentModifiers().shift`; primary = last clicked (`modelActivePartId`); set never empties; stale sets collapse on structural focus moves. `pushPartSetToHost` pushes the union scope + additive face selection; the `__modelPartRangesChanged` handler re-pushes the union after range resyncs.
- Host: `mesh_edit.setEditScopeRanges` (multi-range `faceInScope`, order-mixed mask signature, loud truncation at 64) + `__mesh_edit_scope_ranges` door; pivot = union centroid for free (selection-averaged).
- Row verbs `eye/duplicate/delete` act on the whole set when the pressed row is in it — one host op + **one journal entry per part**, per-part status lines (no faked atomicity).
- Inspector/ModelOutliner: set-member rows highlight; UV header reads `CUBE 1 +N`. (ModelOutliner.tsx got a minimal additive optional `selectedIds` prop — outside my strict file list but model-side and untouched by the parallel session; flagging per instructions.)

**Proof**: meshops `range+rangeadd+scopes` → sel=12 (both parts), union nudge moved both (`r2659_union_move.png`), partition OK after; single-scope nudge moved only part 2 (`r2659_isolation.png`, sel=6, partition OK). New `RJIT_PARTOPS` harness transcript (`r2659c.err`) shows: dup collapse → shiftsel accumulate (primary = last clicked) → group eye hid/showed both set members → single del outside set → shiftsel + group del → honest empty model.

## Item 4 — Island group ids (req_2619 P)

`hostModelAtlasRead` now emits a **parallel `"groups"` array** (one authored group id per island) — chosen over a 5-tuple because `ModelPaintVariants.tsx` and `modelPackageStore.ts` also parse this JSON and 4-stride `islands` consumers keep working. `buildUvPanel` filters: active part's islands (from `__modelActivePartRange`, maintained by AppFrame) keep full strength + borders; all other islands' interiors dim to 0.35; `ModelFocusUv.scope` carries the honest readout, rendered by `UvSection` ("part [0,6) — others dimmed", else "whole model"). Verified in `r2619_uvfilter.png`.

**Verification summary**: `SHIP_RUN_PACKAGE=0 ./tools/rjit ship editor` clean; `zig build test-mesh-edit` passes; all PNGs cited above read and confirmed (in this session's scratchpad); no desktop capture used. Committed with explicit paths only; not pushed; request board untouched.</result>
